title: Per-application finding suppressions
description: security/dast/<app>/suppressions.yaml — the recorded, reviewable decision that a finding is a false positive, an accepted risk, won't be fixed, or belongs to test data (W1-5). A suppressed finding is still scanned and still published; it stops counting toward the report's policy gate and its counts. Accepted risk and won't-fix MUST expire, so the decision is revisited rather than becoming permanent by accident.

fingerprint.description: The finding's identity (detection.schema.json). Rule, endpoint and parameter below are for the human reading this file.

justification.description: Why. A reviewer must be able to check it without asking.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD. After this date the finding counts again and `dast report` says the suppression expired.

github_alert.description: The GitHub alert this was imported from, if any.
